Select approved drugs for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter max_phase_for_indication to 4. Join indication_refs to get the indication label. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return columns chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_indication. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_indication.
